## What

Put the B2.7 compressor into the B2.6 frame path's slot, on the KV260. Run
replayed data first, then live frames from B3.3.

## Done when

- [ ] **Bit-exact on 10 passes.**
- [ ] Keeps up with the budgeted rate.
- [ ] Resource use (LUT, FF, BRAM, DSP) and timing slack logged in
      `docs/STATUS.md`.

## Notes

Replaces `INT-01` (payload top level) and `I-03` (constraints and timing
closure) at the RTL level.
